answer: The dipper coats his barrel a second time with oil, and the second coat must hide every scratch of the first. Oak hazel stave steamer croze bond is the coating: a bond hazel stave steamers lodge after steaming chest inspections. The ocean is the first coat, laid at dawn; the lagoon is the second, laid before the barrel dries, and the mesa is the dawn itself, cold on the cooperage. A forger would need 73 false coats and 73 false dawns.
